what: Operator closed PR #47 (job vwx5) by hand after its content reached main through #48.
why: CI on #47 hung on a pipe deadlock in the test helpers; the fix (em5g, #48) was cut from a branch that already held vwx5's landed commit, so vwx5's content reached main through #48's squash. Athena has no path for a job whose content lands inside a later job's PR.
